subject: Commit corridor sweep — upsell stage clean-up & CS handoff
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Commit corridor sweep — upsell stage clean-up & CS handoff

Team —

Finance asked for a quick corridor sweep of expansion opportunities that are in our commit/at-risk zone this week. I pulled a short list from HubSpot (linked below) and marked the ones where CS already has active renewal/expansion conversations. Goal: get stage updates (can we move to Procure/Closed-Won or do we need to mark as Upside) and capture any blockers so FP&A can model realistic ARR for next month.

Quick asks (this morning):
- Monica / CS: please confirm stage updates for the highlighted accounts and, where possible, a preferred close-week or procurement signal (PO timeline or exec signoff).
- Neha / Sales Ops: if any pricing/discount approvals are pending, flag here — I will coordinate with finance for one-off credits.
- Grace: can you confirm whether any of these should be escalated for executive outreach (>$250k upsell)?

Attached: 20270521-commit-corridor.csv (single-sheet export with current stage, amt, next action) and CloudCo-MAP-v2.pdf (customer success plan). HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/CLD-3472

I'll compile responses into the commit spreadsheet and share back by 3pm PT. If you can't get to everything, mark rows with a short note — partial updates are helpful.

Thanks —
Marcus
VP, Growth | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

--

Thanks Marcus — quick updates below. I'll edit the CSV directly, but pulled the most urgent spots into this thread.

- CloudCo (CLD-3472): moving from "Commit" to "Procure" — customer exec signed off last night; legal requires SOC-2 addendum before PO. Anticipated PO week: 2027-06-07.
- NovaPulse (NVP-889): still "Upside" — CS diagnostic showed product fit gap; CS recommends a pilot before pricing discussion.
- HelioMedia (HLM-120): Can close this week; finance approved standard discount, procurement has PO template ready.

Blockers: CloudCo needs the SOC-2 addendum and one minor clause in the DPA. I've asked their security lead to confirm the exact language (see Jane's reply below).

I'll ping Jane and acct-team for the SOC item and update the CSV as I hear back.

Monica
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

- HelioMedia: mark as Closed-Won, record $48,000 ARR, invoice to be issued with June 1 start date.
